$comment: The shot list for the Caddow starter. Every photograph the site uses is here, with its exact file, size, where it is used, the alt text the content already carries, a self-contained generation prompt and what to exclude. Read galley/photography/ART-DIRECTION.md first. scripts/make-placeholders.mjs paints a placeholder for each; scripts/ingest-photos.mjs crops real photographs (named <id>.<ext>) to these slots using `focus`.

fields.id: Name the generated file <id>.jpg / .png / .webp — ingest matches on it.
fields.file: Final path, relative to the project.
fields.width, height, ratio: Exact output size; the layout reserves this ratio.
fields.alt: The alt text the content uses. Change both together.
fields.seedGroup: Shots that share a model, outfit or set. Generate a group with the same reference image / character reference / seed.
fields.cast, set: The person and the location, as named in ART-DIRECTION.md.
fields.focus: The point to keep when cropping, x and y from 0 (left/top) to 1.
fields.tone: The placeholder's field colour: light, mid, dark, warm or accent (from the active look's --placeholder-* tokens).
fields.priority: 1 = needed for the product demo's first screens; 3 = last.
fields.labelCorner: Optional: where the placeholder prints its title (bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, upper-right), away from any type set on the picture.

shots.title: Campaign — harbour wall
usage: Home page › campaign-hero (sections.0) — full screen, headline bottom-left
Mobile crops it to about 9:19 around her (imageFocus: right)
shots.alt: A woman in a long rust-coloured coat stands against a lime-washed harbour wall, her shadow thrown long across it by a low sun.
shots.prompt: Editorial fashion photograph for Caddow, a small independent coat and knitwear label. She wears the rust car coat: knee-length, single-breasted, boiled wool in a deep oxide rust, a small round collar, covered buttons; over an oat rib-knit polo, wide ink wool trousers and plain black leather shoes. Model A: a woman in her late twenties of East African heritage, close-cropped natural hair, tall and long-necked, no jewellery. Set: the north harbour wall of an invented small northern harbour town — a long, slightly uneven lime-washed wall, chalk white with faint grey weathering, above a quay of large flat pale stone flags; nothing else in frame. Light: hard, low late-afternoon sun about fifteen degrees above the horizon, coming from frame right; clean, slightly warm white light (not orange), crisp long shadows with deep but open, cool shadow detail, a clear pale sky. Camera: full-frame, 35mm lens at f/5.6, eye level, verticals kept straight. Framing: landscape 3:2, full length, she stands in the right third (about 72% across), body turned three-quarters to the left, looking past the camera; her shadow runs long to the left across the wall. Leave headroom and footroom; nothing cut at the feet. Negative space: the left two-thirds of the frame is sunlit wall crossed only by her long shadow, and the lowest third is plain pale stone — the headline is set over the bottom-left, so keep it free of anything busy. Keep a calm strip along the top edge too: the site's navigation sits there. Palette held to chalk white, bone, oat, putty, rust, ink navy and olive-grey. Natural, unretouched skin with visible pores and texture; a relaxed, self-possessed expression, not smiling for the camera; an invented person who resembles no real individual; hands, if visible, relaxed with five correctly formed fingers. Clothing plain and well made, with no logos, labels, lettering or brand marks anywhere. The look of medium-speed colour negative film: fine, even, natural grain, soft highlight roll-off, muted true-to-life colour, gentle contrast, no digital sharpening, no HDR. Spare, assured and a little dry: restraint and attitude, not gloss or glamour.
